What does Juan specialize in?

Real estate operations: MLS input, listing and purchase agreements, amendments, addendums, closing extensions, price changes, withdrawal disclosures, daily compliance inspections, and coordination of showings, photos, inspections, and appraisals.

Is Juan bilingual?

Yes — Juan provides full support in both English and Spanish, which is especially valuable for serving Spanish-speaking buyers, sellers, and clients.

One flat rate of $10 per hour for all services, with flexible hours you can scale up or down as your pipeline changes. Use the calculator above to estimate your weekly or monthly cost.

How soon can Juan start?

Juan is immediately available. Email admin@juanvaservices.com to get started.

How does Juan use AI in his work?

Juan has studied AI across different platforms and developed systems that apply AI to daily tasks — improving completion times and work quality while he personally reviews the work your transactions require.
